title: Algoritma Ketenangan Pagi
theme: Mengeksplorasi bagaimana rutinitas harian yang serba otomatis di kota futuristik dapat memicu refleksi diri dan pencarian makna mendalam.

cover.prompt: A wide shot of a futuristic Neo-Jakarta cityscape at dawn, viewed from inside a minimalist high-rise apartment. Golden morning light gently streams through the transparent panoramic window, illuminating a sleek, empty holographic workspace and vibrant aeroponic plants. The vast, awakening city stretches into the horizon, conveying a mood of peaceful, futuristic serenity.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Arka, a UI/UX designer in a highly automated Neo-Jakarta, feels an existential emptiness despite his perfectly orchestrated life. A minor glitch in his sky-pod forces him to slow down and observe the subtle imperfections and organic details of the city, leading to a profound realization that true serenity comes from embracing minor flaws and human touches, prompting him to rethink his design philosophy.
